Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — SprinterAI / Redwood

Hi Samira & Carlos,

Thanks again for taking time today — really appreciated the candid discussion about SprinterAI's latency and cost constraints for inference at scale. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard
- Target: sub-60ms 95th percentile for short chat queries (<=128 tokens)
- Deployment: private VPC preferred for initial pilot, then dedicated if throughput grows
- Security: SOC2 + ability to review audit logs and KMS integration are blockers for procurement
- Budget: aiming to decide this quarter, ownership currently with Carlos

Proposed next steps
1) I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and owners — can you confirm owners and suggested dates? (Attachment: MutualActionPlan_SprinterAI.xlsx)
2) If you can share approximate monthly active inference tokens and expected concurrency, I can run a quick cost/latency estimate and propose a pilot config.
3) If security needs any evidence, we can arrange a 30-min call with our security engineer next week and share SOC2 artifacts under an NDA.

Asks
- Please confirm whether this is still a priority for this quarter, and if Carlos is the right budget owner.
- Flag any timing risks (procurement freeze, exec travel, etc.).

I’ll follow up early next week — happy to slot a quick 20-min call to get the MAP updated.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
